snippet.title: [OUT NOW] UnderPoint - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm excited to finally announce UnderPoint, a project I've been working on months for and put my heart and soul in.
You can find out more about it here and in my Youtube channel posts section
https://gamejolt.com/games/areweconnected/1007463

By the way, in case you were wondering, yes, this video was also made using exclusively PowerPoint.

#undertale #powerpoint #gaster
